faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know to start your e-commerce journey with confidence and ease.
faq_q1: Do I need capital to start?
faq_a1: No, you do not need a large capital to buy inventory. With the SILACOD system, you can start for free as an affiliate marketer and promote ready products, or use the private-label option and start selling immediately with cash on delivery.
faq_q2: When and how do I receive my profits?
faq_a2: Once the order is delivered to the customer and the amount is collected, profits are added directly to your SILACOD electronic wallet. You can request to withdraw your profits at any time to be sent to your bank account or approved money transfer agencies in Morocco quickly and without delay.
faq_q3: Are the products guaranteed and of high quality?
faq_a3: Yes, all suppliers on the platform are reliable and undergo a strict quality control process to ensure customer satisfaction and minimize returns to the absolute minimum.
faq_q4: How do I start working with SILACOD step-by-step?
faq_a4: Getting started is very easy: create your free account on the platform, browse the marketplace, choose the products that suit you, and start marketing and receiving orders immediately while we handle all operations from confirmation, packaging, and delivery.
